set.body:
Outcome

Demonstrate lawful one-fit-many-compatible-queries behavior.

Acceptance

- One relation fit supports labeled RDM, crossvalidated distance, and RSA where preparation and noise requirements match.
- Signal and nuisance model roles are typed.
- Rank, partial, and regression comparisons state their exact second-order estimands.
- A changed fit, whitening, or preparation requirement forces a distinct plan rather than silent reuse.
set.title: P4B.5: implement RDM and RSA queries over the same compatible relation fit
